verify.title: Check a certificate
verify.intro: Enter the code printed on the certificate. We will confirm whether it was issued through Altus Connect and whether it is still valid.
verify.notFoundBody: Check the code for typing mistakes. If it is correct, the certificate was not issued through Altus Connect or has been withdrawn. Contact the organization named on it.
verify.validTitle: This certificate is genuine and valid
verify.expiredTitle: This certificate is genuine but has expired
verify.revokedTitle: This certificate was issued but is no longer valid
verify.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be created. You can print this page instead.
verify.footer: Verification reads the issuing organization’s records in Altus Connect at the moment you check.

meta.title: Altus Connect | Training, knowledge and certification for hospitality groups

hero.eyebrow: Training, knowledge and certification for hospitality groups
hero.body: Altus Connect assigns the right courses to every team, checks what they learned, issues certificates anyone can verify, and shows compliance hotel by hotel.
hero.note: Accounts are created by your organization's administrator.

preview.score: Pass mark reached on the first attempt

loop.title: One loop, from assignment to evidence
loop.body: Every part of Altus Connect serves the same cycle, so a team's training never lives in scattered spreadsheets.

assign.title: Assign
assign.body: Give courses to a hotel, a department or one person, each with a due date.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Staff work through short lessons on any device, in Arabic or English.

assess.title: Assess
assess.body: A scored quiz confirms the course was understood, not just opened.

certify.title: Certify
certify.body: A pass issues a certificate with a code and QR that anyone can check.

prove.title: Prove
prove.body: See who is complete or overdue by hotel and department, and export the evidence.

roles.title: A clear job for every role in the group

learner.title: Learners
learner.body: See what is due and when, pick up where you left off, and keep every certificate in one place.

author.title: Authors
author.body: Turn the SOPs and documents you already have into draft courses and quizzes with AI, then refine and submit them for review.

manager.title: Training managers
manager.body: Assign training, follow up on overdue work, and answer audits with real records.

admin.title: Administrators
admin.body: Invite people, set roles, and keep brands, hotels and departments in order.

knowledge.title: The right SOP, found in seconds
knowledge.body: Standard operating procedures, guides and policies sit next to the training that teaches them. Staff search in plain words and read the approved version.

points.types: SOPs, guides and policies, each with a named owner
points.review: Every draft is reviewed before it is published
points.current: Owners publish updates and retire outdated versions

knowledge.query: How do I handle a late check-out?

capabilities.title: Made for the way hotel groups work
capabilities.body: From a single hotel to a portfolio of brands, each organization gets a workspace shaped like its business.

ai.title: AI-assisted authoring
ai.body: Start a course from a document you already have. People review every draft before learners see it.

language.title: Arabic and English
language.body: Every screen works in both languages, with a full right-to-left layout.

structure.title: A workspace per organization
structure.body: Brands, hotels, departments and people, with each organization kept separate from the next.

evidence.title: Evidence on demand
evidence.body: Completion and certificate records by hotel and department, ready to export.
